censusTitle: India-wide State / Union Territory Official Exam & Recruitment Authority Census
academicReviewLane: Agent-2 / EID Official Source Research Lane

candidates.candidateName: UPSC DANICS & DANIPS (Union Territories Civil & Police Services)

affectedRegions.regionName: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

candidates.cadresRecruited: DANICS (Delhi, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, Daman & Diu, Dadra & Nagar Haveli Civil Service - Group B Gazetted) and DANIPS (Police Service - Group B Gazetted)
candidates.natureOfOverlap: These administrative and police leadership positions operate at the state/UT executive level (equivalent to SDM/DSP), but are constitutionally and operationally recruited by UPSC under the Ministry of Home Affairs AGMUT cadre umbrella.
candidates.missionRealmRoutingRule: Route preparation to central `upsc_cse_prelims` mission realm. Do NOT create synthetic state PSC missions (e.g. `delhi_psc_prelims` or `lakshadweep_psc`) because no such state/UT commissions exist for these territories.

candidates.candidateName: SSC Delhi Police Constable & Sub-Inspector Recruitment
candidates.examConducted: SSC Delhi Police Constable (Executive) Exam & SSC CPO (Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPFs) Exam
candidates.cadresRecruited: Constable (Executive) Male/Female and Sub-Inspector (Executive) in Delhi Police
candidates.natureOfOverlap: Delhi Police is a state/metropolitan law enforcement agency, but because GNCTD is a Union Territory with police under Ministry of Home Affairs control, recruitment examinations are conducted centrally by SSC.
candidates.missionRealmRoutingRule: Exams can be displayed in Delhi state catalog with badge 'Conducted by Central SSC', mapped to canonical mission keys `delhi_police_constable` and `ssc_cpo_delhi_police_si`.

candidates.cadresRecruited: Non-Gazetted Group B and Group C posts in the Administration of UT Ladakh
candidates.natureOfOverlap: UT Ladakh has no state-level subordinate selection board. The UT administration entered into a statutory MOU with Central SSC to conduct selection tests for UT departmental posts.
candidates.missionRealmRoutingRule: Categorize under UT Ladakh subordinate recruitment realm with explicit attribution to SSC Selection Posts testing framework.

candidates.candidateName: Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) for States/UTs without State TET

affectedRegions.regionName: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

candidates.examConducted: Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET Paper 1 & Paper 2)
candidates.cadresRecruited: Eligibility certification for Primary (Classes 1-5) and Upper Primary (Classes 6-8) teachers
candidates.natureOfOverlap: Goa, Chandigarh, and Union Territories do not conduct independent annual state TET examinations; statutory teacher recruitment rules adopt CBSE CTET scores as mandatory eligibility.
candidates.missionRealmRoutingRule: Direct teaching aspirants from these territories to the unified `cbse_ctet` mission realm with state eligibility tagging.

candidates.candidateName: Chandigarh Administration Inter-State Cadre Quota (Punjab 60% : Haryana 40%)
candidates.centralAuthority: Punjab Government & Haryana Government / PPSC / HPSC / PSSSB / HSSC
candidates.examConducted: Punjab & Haryana State Civil Services and Subordinate examinations
candidates.cadresRecruited: Administrative, Education, and Engineering officers serving in Chandigarh UT on deputation
candidates.natureOfOverlap: By inter-governmental agreement, 60% of administrative posts in Chandigarh are drawn from Punjab cadre and 40% from Haryana cadre. Subordinate posts are either recruited via Chandigarh Education Department / CCET or deputation.
candidates.missionRealmRoutingRule: Chandigarh administrative aspirants must be guided to `ppsc_cce` or `hpsc_hcs`, while direct recruitment (Chandigarh Police Constable/ASI) is mapped to `ch_police_constable`.

candidates.candidateName: High Courts Territorial Jurisdiction over Subordinate Judiciary
candidates.centralAuthority: State High Courts (Constitutional Bodies under Art. 214-231)

affectedRegions.regionName: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

candidates.examConducted: Judicial Services Examination (Civil Judge Junior Division & District Judge) and High Court Registry Staff (LDC/Assistant/Stenographer)
candidates.cadresRecruited: Subordinate Judicial Officers and High Court Ministerial Staff
candidates.natureOfOverlap: Gauhati High Court exercises territorial jurisdiction over 4 NE states (AS, AR, NL, MZ); Bombay High Court covers MH, GA, DN; Madras High Court covers TN and PY; Kerala High Court covers KL and LD; Punjab & Haryana High Court covers PB, HR, and CH.
candidates.missionRealmRoutingRule: Judicial services recruitment belongs to separate Judicial Realm under High Court authority, segregated from Executive State PSC / Subordinate boards.

candidates.candidateName: Assam Rifles (Central Paramilitary Force under MHA)
candidates.centralAuthority: Directorate General Assam Rifles, Shillong / Ministry of Home Affairs
candidates.examConducted: Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesmen Recruitment Rally & SSC GD Constable
candidates.cadresRecruited: Rifleman (General Duty), Havildar (Clerk), and Warrant Officers in Assam Rifles
candidates.natureOfOverlap: Despite having 'Assam' in the name, Assam Rifles is India's oldest Central Paramilitary Force under the operational control of the Indian Army and administrative control of the MHA. It is NOT part of the Assam State Police.
candidates.missionRealmRoutingRule: Route preparation to central `ssc_gd_constable` and central defense recruitment tracks; strictly exclude from state police catalogs.

candidates.candidateName: Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) State-Specific Officer & Office Assistant Intake

affectedRegions.regionName: All 28 States and UTs with RRBs

candidates.examConducted: IBPS CRP RRBs (Officers Scale I, II, III & Office Assistant)
candidates.cadresRecruited: Branch Managers, Agricultural Field Officers, Office Assistants in Gramin Banks
candidates.natureOfOverlap: Gramin Banks operate within specific state borders (e.g. Prathama UP Gramin Bank, Aryavart Bank, Kerala Gramin Bank, Assam Gramin Vikash Bank), leading students to search for them under state exams, but recruitment is 100% centrally conducted by IBPS.
candidates.missionRealmRoutingRule: Route to central `ibps_rrb_po` and `ibps_rrb_clerk` mission realms with state-wise language and vacancy filter options.
